newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Pioneer Aggressive Fund rises 75.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Polish Pioneer Aggressive Fund rises 75.8 pct.

text.p: Polish Pioneer Aggressive Trust Fund net asset value per unit rose by 75.8 percent to 17.58 zlotys since it started operating a year ago, deputy president of Pioneer First Trust Fund Co said.
Marek Zytniewski told a news conference that given a maximum sales charge of 5.5 percent the fund had brought a 66.1 percent return.
"It seems the fund was created in a good moment, it has used this year's growth on the Warsaw bourse and we hope the fund will continue its growth," he said.
During the year clients entrusted it a total of 277.6 million zlotys and opened 30,000 registers.
Stocks, which amounted to more 64 percent of the Aggressive Fund's portfolio, rose 124.6 percent during the year.
The remaining 36 percent were secure debt instruments such as bonds.
